document.title: Afghanistan: Bin Ladin's Interest in Biological and Radiological Weapons
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: States that Bin Ladin and associates have experimented by crude means to make and deploy biological agents, and that Bin Ladin has sought military-grade biological agents or weapons.
